definitions.explanation: Information or updates from someone, especially someone far away.
Written communication, especially a personal letter.

examples.japanese: {息子|むすこ}から{便|たよ}りがあった。
examples.english: I received word from my son.

examples.japanese: {便|たよ}りがないのは{良|よ}い{便|たよ}り。
{友人|ゆうじん}に{便|たよ}りを{書|か}く。
examples.english: To write a letter to a friend.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {便|たよ}りがある (to receive news/a letter)
- {便|たよ}りがない (no news, no word)
- {便|たよ}りを{出|だ}す (to send a letter/news)

PROVERB:
- {便|たよ}りがないのは{良|よ}い{便|たよ}り: No news is good news

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {便|たよ}り: News/letter (slightly literary/traditional)
- {手紙|てがみ}: Letter (most common word)
- {連絡|れんらく}: Contact, communication (modern/practical)

NOTE: Though somewhat old-fashioned, {便|たよ}り is still used especially when referring to news from people far away or occasional correspondence.
